purpose.zh: 拉伸前腿臀部和后腿髋前侧
purpose.en: Stretch the glute of the front leg and the front of the back hip.

text.zh: 上身直立，双手扶砖，呼气时微微前倾
text.en: Stay tall with hands on the blocks and lean forward slightly as you exhale

text.zh: 前腿小腿横在身前，后腿向后伸直
text.en: Front shin across your body, back leg straight behind you.

text.zh: 骨盆尽量摆正，不要硬往下压
text.en: Keep your hips as square as you can and do not force them down.

commonErrors.en: Letting the pelvis tilt to one side.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼痛时垫高臀部或换成仰卧4字拉伸
cautions.en: If your knee hurts, prop your hips up or switch to the supine figure-4 stretch.
